messages:
mira-product: Heads up — prepping the Q3 roadmap PRD for Dedicated capacity. Need decisions on isolation modes for burst + SLA tiers. Quick sync?

jamal-eng: Short list of options: 1) hard tenant isolation (no sharing), 2) soft isolation with preemptible shared pool, 3) credit-based burst on top of reserved commit. Each has different perf/cost tradeoffs.

sofia-sre: From SRE POV we need explicit SLOs (p99 latency, tail latency percentiles, and uptime %). Also define eviction/preemption policy and cooldown windows for burst nodes.

kevin-sales: Sales input: large enterprise customers ask for "hard isolation" for compliance — they'll pay a premium. Mid-market customers want cheaper burst options instead of full reservations.

emma-cs: Example customer ask: Customer A (healthcare) wants private Dedicated with burst for nightly batch peaks but cannot accept noisy-neighbor latency spikes. They need guarantees.

liam-ml: Technical note: model KV cache warmup is non-trivial on burst nodes. Cold-start tokens produce huge tail latency. We should consider aggressive pre-warming or cache pinning for enterprise pilots.

jamal-eng: Proposed config example (MVP sketch):
```
mode: isolated-burst
commit_gpus: 4
burst_credit_hours: 48
preemptible_policy: "evict-lru"
cache_pin: [model_v1, model_v1_quant]
```
Also: telemetry hooks for cache-hit-rate and warmup latency.

sofia-sre: Operational concerns: capacity accounting + billing accuracy when bursts span reserved + shared pools. Need per-tenant telemetry: token-cost, preemption events, cache hits, and SLA breach signals.

mira-product: Draft launch criteria I propose: (1) isolation mode implemented in API + scheduler, (2) SLA doc + pricing tiers published, (3) autoscale test harness that runs synthetic spikes across 50 tenants, (4) CS runbook + support playbook. Agree?

kevin-sales: Add: migration playbook for customers moving from hosted -> dedicated, and clear contract language for preemption/burst credits. Sales will need pricing bands.

emma-cs: Also add a behavioral test suite to ensure deterministic fallback behavior (i.e., when we downgrade a model or route to a smaller instance, outputs remain acceptable). Customers care about quality regressions.

jamal-eng: Rough timeline from eng: MVP (API + scheduler + basic isolation) in ~10 weeks; +6 weeks for telemetry/billing integration; +4 weeks for docs/legal and pilot setup. Risks: infra churn, over-commit of GPUs, and unexpected tail latency.

mira-product: Prioritization thought: ship a minimal hard-isolation MVP (basic guarantees) + support credit-based burst as phase 2. OKR target: ship Dedicated isolation MVP + 2 paying pilots by EoQ. Thoughts?

sofia-sre: :thumbsup: from infra. We'll need acceptance test signoff criteria (p99 under load, <1% preemption rate during normal ops).

deploy-bot: deployment scheduled: feature/isolation-mvp -> staging at 1782468500, prod canary at 1782469200

jamal-eng: I'll draft the PRD with a decision matrix (cost vs isolation vs latency risk) and include a simple cost model for 3 customer profiles. Ping me to add constraints.

kevin-sales: I'll loop in legal for contract language around credits and SLA exceptions. Also will surface pilot candidates from finance and two large customers.

mira-product: Great — final sync Friday 10am to lock prioritization. Agenda: launch criteria, pricing tiers, pilot candidates, and rollback plans. @kevin-sales @sofia-sre please bring risk notes and acceptance test definitions.
